issues.explanation: Chapter 75 says “此后关羽擒于禁、斩庞德” after the Hua Tuo treatment, but Chapter 74 already depicts those events before Guan Yu is wounded and before the treatment. This reverses the established sequence.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with wording such as“此前关羽擒于禁、斩庞德，威震华夏” or “关羽擒于禁、斩庞德的消息传到许都”.
